beats.cap: Kerala: about 1 hectare in 18 lies idle · 2023-24 (provisional)

beats.say: Across India, it is about one in five.
In twenty eleven, Kerala packed eight hundred and sixty people into each square kilometre.
That census found just one village in Kerala where nobody lived.
In ten years, land under buildings, roads and water grew sixteen percent.
Over a quarter is classed as forest, a legal label, wooded or not.
Still, Punjab and West Bengal have even less idle land.
But in Kerala, only about one hectare in eighteen lies idle.
beats.cap: Kerala: about 1 in 18 idle · India: about 1 in 5
